_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your own paths and ids. Every value here is a placeholder or empty; the skill will stop and ask if it needs something you have not set.

zotero._api_comment: db_path/data_dir are used by the lookup scripts. user_id and api_key are only used by zotero_write.py: create a key at https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys with library access + write access (+ notes access if you also write child notes).
zotero._collection_comment: Every item the skill writes is filed into this collection. Notion is the source of truth; the collection is only the boundary of what to back up and audit. Set to "" to file nothing.

notion._properties_comment: Maps the skill's fixed concept names to the actual field names in your papers database. If a concept here has no matching field in the database, the skill stops and reports it rather than dropping the value.
notion._option_values_comment: The legal values of the select fields. read_level, type and verdict are the ones the skill sets on its own.

_tag_prefix_comment: Zotero tags are flat, so each tag family is carried by a prefix. Notion uses three separate multi-select fields and needs no prefix.
